suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Document a safe procedure for proving config-validation failures are pre-existing without using `git stash` on a dirty tree.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: The `update-docker-configs` transcript used `git stash && ... && git stash pop` to compare a compose validation failure because the skill had no safer pre-existing-failure triage guidance.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Explicitly allow verification-only frontend/config features to complete with scoped checks when no code edits are needed, instead of implying `test_frontend` is always required.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: The `update-pm2-package-configs` review found the feature was correctly completed as a no-op verification task using `tsc -b`, `vite build`, and greps, but the skill text currently suggests frontend work should always run `test_frontend`.
